head.title: Privacy Policy — Personal
head.description: What Personal collects, why, who it is shared with, how long it is kept, and how to erase all of it.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.lede: Personal only works with what you hand it: your professional Instagram account, your positioning, and the moments of your life you write down. This page states exactly what we collect, why, who it is shared with, how long it is kept, and how to erase all of it.

summary.title: The short version, in five points

noSale.detail: Your data is never sold, rented or handed to data brokers, and it powers no targeted advertising.

noPost.detail: Nothing is published, scheduled or sent to your Instagram account unless you press the button yourself.

noTraining.detail: Text sent to our AI providers goes through their business APIs, whose terms exclude training their models on our requests.

private.detail: Your Moments, your creator profile and your drafts are never shown to another creator, in any form.

delete.detail: Disconnecting Instagram immediately deletes the access token and every imported media item. Deleting your account erases the rest.

p.who: The controller under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is the publisher of the Personal service, available at usepersonal.app: [LEGAL ENTITY — legal form, registered address, company number].
p.contact: For any question about this policy, or to exercise your rights, write to privacy{'@'}usepersonal.app. We answer within one month at the latest.
p.dpo: Given the size of the service and the nature of the processing, no data protection officer has been appointed: requests are handled directly by the publisher.

data.title: The data we process

p.intro: Personal collects only what the product needs in order to work. These are all the categories, as they actually exist in our database.

account.detail: Your name, your email address, your password (stored only as a bcrypt hash, never in clear text), the date your address was verified, and your browser session tokens.

instagram.detail: The public information of your professional account and your recent posts, detailed in the next section.

profile.detail: Your niche, your audience description, your positioning, your tone, your topics, your current projects, your goals and your strengths — whether you write them yourself or they are inferred from your posts and then submitted to you for approval.

moments.detail: The free-form notes you save to ground your content, their category and their dates. This is the most personal data in the service: write only what you would be willing to tell your audience, and avoid recording sensitive data (health, political or religious views, sexual orientation) or information about identifiable third parties.

creations.detail: The Reel, carousel and caption drafts generated for you, the versions you edit, and the posts you save or dismiss in the feed.

chat.detail: The messages you exchange with the creative assistant, sent to our AI provider along with your profile context for as long as it takes to produce an answer. They are not stored on our servers.

technical.detail: IP address, browser type, request timestamps and error messages, written to the server logs for security and diagnostics.

data.note: We collect no payment data (the service is free during early access), no precise location data and no advertising identifiers.

p.how: The connection runs on Instagram Login, Meta's official mechanism for professional accounts. You authenticate with Instagram, never with us: we never see your Instagram password. Meta returns an access token, which we encrypt before writing it to the database and never expose to the browser.
p.scopes: The permissions requested are instagram_business_basic (profile and posts), instagram_business_manage_insights (statistics for your posts) and instagram_business_content_publish (publishing content, reserved for an action you trigger yourself).

profileFields.detail: Instagram ID, username, display name, account type, biography, website, profile picture, follower count, following count and media count.

mediaFields.detail: Up to your 25 most recent posts: caption, media type (image, video, Reel, carousel), permalink, media and thumbnail URL, publication date, like count and comment count.

insights.detail: Where Meta provides them: views, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves and total interactions, post by post.

never.detail: Your direct messages, the list or identity of your followers, the comments your followers leave, your Meta payment information, and data about the accounts you follow.

outro.publish: The publishing permission exists for one thing only: publishing content you have approved, at the moment you ask for it. Personal never publishes, schedules or deletes anything on its own initiative.
outro.revoke: You can withdraw this access at any time, from Personal's Settings or from Instagram itself. The “Erasing your data” section describes both routes.
outro.meta: Our use of information received from Meta complies with the Meta Platform Terms and the Meta Developer Policies. We pass that information to no third party beyond the processors listed below, and we use it for no advertising purpose.

p.intro: Every processing operation serves a defined purpose and rests on a legal basis set out in the GDPR.

service.term: Providing the service — performance of the contract
service.detail: Creating and securing your account, importing your posts, building your For You feed, generating drafts, and keeping your Moments and saved content.

personalisation.term: Personalising recommendations — performance of the contract
personalisation.detail: Matching the formats that genuinely work in your niche against your positioning and your life moments, so that only what sounds like you is suggested.

connection.detail: Access to your account rests on the permission you grant at Meta. You can withdraw it at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out beforehand.

emails.term: Sending service email — performance of the contract
emails.detail: Address verification, password resets and messages essential to the life of your account. No marketing without your prior agreement.

security.detail: Rate limiting, abuse detection, technical logs and backups. Our interest is protecting accounts, and it never overrides your fundamental rights and freedoms.

improve.detail: Understanding errors and usage in order to fix and evolve the service. We work on aggregated or anonymised data wherever that is possible.

analytics.detail: Understanding pages viewed and navigation within Personal through Google Analytics in cookieless mode. Advertising and personalisation features are disabled.

p.what: Drafts and assistant replies are written by language models operated by OpenAI and, depending on the service configuration, Anthropic. We send them only what the request needs: the post being analysed, the selected life moment, your creator profile and your message.
p.training: These calls go through their business APIs. Under those terms the data sent is not used to train their models; the provider may retain it briefly for abuse detection, after which it is deleted.
p.decisions: No decision producing legal effects or similarly significantly affecting you is made automatically. A model proposes text; you decide everything else.
p.quality: A model can be wrong. Always read a draft before publishing it: you remain the author of, and responsible for, what you post.

p.what: The For You feed is built from public posts by other Instagram accounts in your niche. We collect them through our provider Apify, from hashtag pages and public profiles.
p.fields: We keep what makes a post comparable: public username, display name, profile picture, biography, follower count and the account's average engagement, and for each post its hook, caption, thumbnail, date and public counters.
p.basis: The legal basis is our legitimate interest in producing trend analysis from information their authors have made public. We access no private account, no message and no data that is not already visible to everyone. This information serves performance analysis only: it is never used to contact those creators, nor to republish their content.
p.rights: If you are a creator and do not want your posts analysed by Personal, write to privacy{'@'}usepersonal.app: we remove your account and your posts from our database and prevent them from reappearing.

sharing.title: Who your data is shared with

p.intro: We sell and rent no data. We rely on a small number of processors, each for one defined task, all bound by a contract compliant with Article 28 GDPR.

meta.detail: Source of your professional account data, through Instagram Login. Ireland and United States.

openai.detail: Generation of drafts and creative assistant replies. United States.

anthropic.detail: Content generation when that engine is selected. United States.

apify.detail: Collection of the public posts used for trend analysis. Czech Republic, European Union.

resend.detail: Delivery of service email (address verification, account security). United States.

google.detail: Cookieless measurement of pages viewed and navigation. Google Ireland Limited, with processing that may take place in the United States.

hosting.detail: Application server and PostgreSQL database hosted with [HOSTING PROVIDER], in the European Union. Domain name and DNS zone managed by OVH (France).

sharing.note: We may also disclose data to a judicial or administrative authority where the law requires it, and to our legal or accounting advisers where necessary.

p.text: Some of our processors are established in the United States. Those transfers are governed by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses and, where the provider is certified under it, by the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. You can request a copy of the applicable safeguards at privacy{'@'}usepersonal.app.

account.detail: For as long as your account exists, then erased within 30 days of your deletion request.

instagram.term: Access token and imported Instagram media
instagram.detail: Deleted immediately when you disconnect Instagram or delete your account. The token also stops being valid on its own if it is not refreshed.

moments.detail: For as long as you keep them. Deleting from the app erases the record from the database.

chat.detail: Not stored on our servers: the exchange lives in your browser and disappears when you clear it or reload the page.

discovery.detail: Refreshed regularly; a post leaves the feed once it falls outside the analysis window (30 days by default) and stale measurements are overwritten.

logs.detail: 12 months at most, in line with recommended practice on traceability.

backups.detail: Deleted data may survive in an encrypted backup for at most 30 days before disappearing for good.

transport.detail: All traffic between your browser, our API and our providers runs over HTTPS/TLS.

tokens.detail: The Meta access token is encrypted at rest with the application key and is never sent to the browser.

passwords.detail: Stored as bcrypt hashes at 12 rounds. Nobody, ourselves included, can read them.

access.detail: Every authenticated call requires a revocable personal token; signing out revokes it immediately.

ratelimit.detail: Sensitive endpoints — sign-in, registration, content generation — are capped by request rate.

breach.detail: In an incident posing a risk to your rights, we notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours and inform you directly where the risk is high.

rights.title: Your rights

p.intro: The GDPR grants you the following rights. Exercise them at any time by writing to privacy{'@'}usepersonal.app from your account's email address.

access.detail: Confirm whether we process data about you and receive a copy of it.

rectification.detail: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data. Most fields can be edited directly in Settings and Personal.

erasure.detail: Request deletion of your data, under the conditions described in the next section.

portability.detail: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format, or have it transmitted to another controller.

opposition.detail: Object, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to processing based on our legitimate interest.

limitation.detail: Ask for processing to be frozen while a dispute is examined.

withdraw.detail: Revoke Instagram access at any time, without justification and without consequence for the rest of your account.

postmortem.detail: Set out what should happen to your data after your death, as provided by French data protection law.

complaint.detail: Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority — in France, the CNIL, 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07, cnil.fr — if you believe your rights are not respected.

rights.note: We answer within one month, extendable by two months for complex requests, in which case we tell you. We may ask you to verify your identity where there is reasonable doubt about who is making the request.

deletion.title: Erasing your data

p.intro: There are four routes, from the most targeted to the most complete. None of them requires a justification.

disconnect.detail: In Personal: Settings → Instagram → Disconnect. The access token and every imported media item are deleted from our database immediately.

revoke.detail: In the Instagram app: Settings → Websites and apps → Personal → Remove. Access stops at once on Meta's side and the token becomes unusable.

content.detail: Every Moment, draft and saved post can be deleted from the screen it appears on, without going through us.

account.detail: Write to privacy{'@'}usepersonal.app from your account's email address, with the subject “Account deletion”. We erase the account, the creator profile, the Moments, the drafts, the imported media and the Instagram token, and confirm it by email within 30 days.

deletion.note: The only things that remain are data the law requires us to keep, if any, and other creators' public posts, which are not about you.

p.intro: Personal uses no advertising cookie or social network tracker. Google Analytics runs with analytics storage denied and therefore sets no audience measurement cookie. The only cookies set are necessary for the service to work.

token.detail: Keeps your authenticated session. Deleted when you sign out.

lang.detail: Remembers the display language you chose.

onboarding.detail: Remembers that you chose to skip the Instagram connection step. Lifetime: one year.

p.text: Personal is aimed at creators with a professional Instagram account and is not intended for people under 16. If you become aware that someone under 16 has created an account, write to us: we will delete the data concerned without delay.

This policy evolves with the product. The last updated date sits at the top of this page. Any substantial change — a new purpose, a new processor receiving your personal data, a change in retention — is notified to you by email or in the app before it takes effect.

p.mail: Write to privacy{'@'}usepersonal.app for any question, rights request or report related to this policy.

head.title: Terms of Service — Personal
head.description: The agreement between you and Personal: what the service does, what you may publish, what artificial intelligence does not guarantee, and how either side ends it.

hero.title: Terms of Service
hero.lede: These terms are the agreement between you and Personal. They say what the service does, what we owe you, what you owe us, and how either of us can end it. They are written to be read, not to be skipped.

summary.title: The short version, in six points

free.detail: Personal costs nothing during early access. No payment method is requested, and no existing feature becomes payable without notice and your agreement.

yours.detail: You keep every right to your Moments, your drafts and your posts. We hold only the permission needed to run the service for you.

author.detail: A model writes a draft; you read it, edit it and decide to publish. What ends up on your account is yours, and so is the responsibility for it.

noPost.detail: Personal holds no permission to post, schedule or send anything on your Instagram account. Publishing stays a manual act.

beta.detail: Features change, outages happen, and we promise no uninterrupted availability. We tell you before anything substantial changes.

leave.term: You can leave at any moment
leave.detail: Delete your account whenever you want, without justification, without penalty and without losing anything you have already published.

p.accept: These terms govern your use of Personal, the service published at usepersonal.app and its subdomains. Creating an account, or simply using the service, means you accept them in full. If you do not accept them, do not use Personal.
p.who: They apply whether you use Personal as an individual creator or on behalf of a company. If you accept them for a company, you confirm you have the authority to bind it.
p.together: They are read together with our Privacy Policy, which describes what we do with your personal data and forms part of the same agreement.

p.who: Personal is published by [LEGAL ENTITY — legal form, registered address, company number], acting as service provider under these terms.

service.title: What the service does

p.intro: Personal is a writing tool for Instagram creators. It reads what already works in your niche, holds on to the moments of your life you write down, and proposes drafts that sound like you. Concretely, an account gives you:

feed.detail: Public posts by creators in your niche, ranked by what is genuinely performing rather than by recency.

moments.detail: A private place to write down what happens to you, so that a draft has something true to draw from.

remix.detail: A draft written from a post that works and one of your moments, which you can rewrite as many times as you need.

chat.detail: A conversation to sharpen an angle, a hook or a caption.

profile.detail: Your positioning, your voice and your subjects, against which every suggestion is measured.

instagram.detail: Optional. It imports your public account information and your recent posts so that suggestions rest on your real numbers.

service.note: This describes the service as it stands today. Features arrive, change and occasionally disappear; the “Availability and changes” section says how we handle that.

p.intro: An account is personal, individual and tied to a verified email address.

age.detail: Personal is aimed at creators with a professional Instagram account. You must be at least 16 years old to open an account.

truth.detail: The name and email address you give must be yours and must be current. An unverified address blocks access to most of the service.

security.detail: You are responsible for your password and for everything done from your account. Write to legal{'@'}usepersonal.app if you believe someone else has access to it, and change your password from Settings.

sharing.detail: Do not share, sell or transfer your account. You may connect different Instagram accounts over time, but one Personal account belongs to one person.

p.free: Personal is free during early access. No payment method is requested, and no charge can be applied to you.
p.later: Paid plans may appear later. If that happens, we announce it by email at least 30 days beforehand, the new conditions apply only once you have accepted them, and you always keep the choice to leave rather than pay.
p.costs: Your own costs — internet access, device, your Instagram account — remain yours.

p.optional: Connecting your professional Instagram account is optional and reversible. It goes through Instagram Login, at Meta, and we never see your Instagram password.
p.scope: The connection gives Personal read access only: your public profile information, your recent posts and their public statistics. Personal holds no permission to publish, to comment, to send messages or to follow accounts on your behalf.

meta.detail: Your use of the connection is also governed by the Instagram Terms of Use and the Meta Platform Terms. On that point, where they conflict with these terms, they prevail.

eligible.detail: The connection requires an Instagram professional account — creator or business — as Meta requires for this API.

revoke.detail: Disconnect from Settings in Personal, or remove Personal from Instagram: Settings → Websites and apps. The access token and every imported media item are deleted immediately.

beyond.detail: Meta may change, restrict or interrupt its API at any time. If it does, part of the service can stop working without that being a failure on our side.

outro.publish: Publishing stays a manual act: you copy the text you have approved and post it yourself from Instagram. Nothing leaves Personal for your account on its own.

ai.title: What artificial intelligence does, and what it does not promise

p.what: Drafts and assistant replies are produced by language models operated by third parties. We send them only what the request needs: the post being analysed, the moment you selected, your creator profile and your message.
p.review: A model can be wrong, invent a fact, or produce a text close to something that already exists. Read every draft before it leaves Personal. You are the last check, and the only one that counts.
p.author: Once you have reviewed and published a text, you are its author. You alone answer for what it says, for the claims it makes, and for its compliance with the rules on advertising, sponsorship disclosure and intellectual property.
p.noResult: No result is promised. Personal guarantees no reach, no engagement, no follower growth and no income. Nobody can guarantee those.
p.quota: Generation is subject to fair-use limits so that the service stays available to everyone. We may adjust those limits, and we tell you when they change substantially.

p.intro: Your Moments, your creator profile, your drafts and your published posts belong to you. Nothing here transfers any right in them to us.

licence.detail: To run the service, you grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to host, store, reproduce and process your content — solely to display it back to you, produce what you ask for, and operate the service. It lasts as long as you keep the content, and no longer.

noTraining.term: No model is trained on it
noTraining.detail: Your content is never used to train an AI model, ours or anyone else's, is never sold, and is never shown to another creator.

warrant.detail: That you hold the rights to whatever you put into Personal, and that it infringes nobody's rights — image, privacy, trade mark or copyright included.

backup.detail: Keep a copy of anything that matters to you. We back the service up, but Personal is not an archive service and cannot guarantee recovery.

p.what: The feed shows public posts by other Instagram accounts in your niche, collected from public pages for analysis. They are there so you can understand what works, not so you can copy it.
p.rule: Reproducing another creator's post word for word is your responsibility, not ours, and may infringe their rights. A remix exists precisely so that what you publish comes out of your own material.
p.takedown: If you are a creator and do not want your posts analysed by Personal, write to legal{'@'}usepersonal.app: we remove your account and your posts from our database and prevent them from reappearing.

rules.title: What you may not do

p.intro: Using Personal to produce or spread the following is a breach of these terms:

illegal.detail: Content that is illegal, defamatory, hateful, harassing or violent, or that infringes a third party's rights.

minors.detail: Any content that endangers, sexualises or exploits a minor, in any form whatsoever.

deception.detail: Impersonating someone, faking an identity or an endorsement, publishing sponsored content without disclosing it, or making misleading claims about health, money or results.

spam.detail: Producing content at volume for spam or artificial engagement, or reselling access to the service as a generation tool.

technical.detail: Scraping the service, circumventing our rate limits, reverse-engineering it, probing its security without our written agreement, or reaching it through an unauthorised automated client.

competing.detail: Using Personal, its output or its data to build, train or evaluate a competing product.

rules.note: If you come across something from this list on Personal, tell us at legal{'@'}usepersonal.app. We look at every report.

p.ours: The Personal service — its code, its interface, its design, its name and its logo — belongs to the publisher and is protected. These terms grant you a personal, non-transferable right to use it, and nothing more.
p.output: The texts generated for you are yours to use freely, including commercially. We claim no right over them. Note that a model may produce a similar text for someone else: no exclusivity can be guaranteed over a generated output.
p.feedback: If you send us an idea or a suggestion about the product, we may use it without owing you anything, and without that giving us any right over the rest of your content.

p.asis: The service is provided as it is, in early access. We put real care into it, but we do not promise that it will be available without interruption, free of error, or that it will meet a specific need of yours.
p.maintenance: We may interrupt the service for maintenance, security or a technical failure. Where an interruption is planned and significant, we announce it beforehand.
p.evolve: Features can be added, changed or withdrawn as the product develops. Where a change substantially reduces what the service does, we notify you by email or in the app before it takes effect, and you remain free to delete your account.
p.deps: Part of the service depends on third parties — Meta, our AI providers, our host. Their outages become ours, and that is outside our control.

p.intro: Either side can end it. Nobody is held here.

you.detail: Stop using the service, or ask us to delete your account by writing to privacy{'@'}usepersonal.app from your account's address. The erasure procedure is described in the Privacy Policy.

us.detail: We may suspend or close an account that breaches these terms, endangers the service or its users, or is used unlawfully. Except where the breach is serious or unlawful, we warn you first and give you a chance to put it right.

effect.detail: Closing the account ends your right to use the service and triggers the deletion of your data under the conditions set out in the Privacy Policy. Clauses meant to survive it — intellectual property, liability, governing law — do.

shutdown.detail: If we ever discontinue the service, we tell you at least 30 days beforehand and leave you the means to retrieve your content.

p.ours: We are liable for damage resulting directly from our own failure to meet these terms. That liability is neither excluded nor limited where the law forbids it — in particular for death or personal injury, gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
p.not: We are not liable for what we do not control: the content you decide to publish, the results it does or does not produce, decisions taken by Instagram about your account, or the failure of a third-party service.
p.cap: Where the law allows a limit and you use Personal for professional purposes, our total liability is capped at the greater of the sums you paid us in the twelve months preceding the event and one hundred euros. Nothing in this section restricts the rights a consumer holds under mandatory law.
p.yours: You answer for the use you make of the service, and you hold us harmless from any third-party claim arising from content you published or from your breach of these terms.

p.list: Personal relies on Meta for the Instagram connection, on OpenAI and Anthropic for generation, on Apify for collecting public posts, and on Resend for service email. Using Personal means those services are involved, each under its own terms.
p.links: The service may point to sites we do not operate. We are not responsible for what is on them.

p.policy: How we handle your personal data — what we collect, why, who it is shared with, how long it is kept and how to erase it — is set out in full in our Privacy Policy, which forms part of this agreement.
p.link: Read it at usepersonal.app/privacy. If a point of these terms and a point of that policy disagree about personal data, the Privacy Policy prevails.

p.how: These terms evolve with the product. The last updated date sits at the top of this page.
p.notice: Any substantial change is notified by email or in the app at least 30 days before it takes effect. Continuing to use Personal after that date means you accept the new version; if you would rather not, delete your account before then, at no cost.

p.law: These terms are governed by French law. If you are a consumer resident in another European Union country, you keep the protection of the mandatory rules of your own country.
p.first: In a dispute, write to us first at legal{'@'}usepersonal.app. Most things are settled there, and faster.
p.mediation: If you are a consumer and our answer does not satisfy you, you may refer the matter free of charge to a consumer mediator: [CONSUMER MEDIATOR — name, postal address and website], within one year of your written complaint.
p.court: Failing agreement, the dispute goes before the competent courts. Where you act as a professional, jurisdiction lies with the courts of [PUBLISHER'S REGISTERED OFFICE], including for urgent proceedings and where there are several defendants.

p.mail: Write to legal{'@'}usepersonal.app for anything concerning these terms: a question, a report, a rights claim or a formal notice.
p.privacy: For anything concerning your personal data, privacy{'@'}usepersonal.app reaches the same people, faster.
